Name: Auto Forager - Moss Mania
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color]
I configured Auto Forager so that it will no longer automatically forage moss.
Even if you walk near moss-covered trees, Auto Forager will not react.
Moss must now be collected manually with a scythe.


[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[b][color=#00ffff][u]Overwrite the downloaded config.json file.[/u][/color][/b]


[color=#e06666][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]
You need to download the Auto Forager mod separately.
